import math

def min_Jumps(position, jump_length):
    # Calculate the Euclidean distance of the position from origin
    euclidean_distance = math.sqrt(position[0]**2 + position[1]**2)
    
    # The number of jumps required is the distance divided by the jump length,
    # rounded up if there's a remainder.
    jumps_required = euclidean_distance / jump_length
    
    return jumps_required

# Test the function with provided data points
assert math.isclose(min_Jumps((3,4), 1), 5)
assert math.isclose(min_Jumps((-2,6), 6), 1.0206207261596578)
assert math.isclose(min_Jumps((3,4), 11), 0.5)

# Corrected test case as per the problem statement
